app.name: AyurAuth
app.tagline: Know your herbs before you buy
app.footer: A B2C authenticity app for shoppers of Ayurvedic herbs

landing.heroTitle: Shop Ayurvedic herbs you can actually trust
landing.heroDescription: AyurAuth is built for you — the buyer. Scan the QR on a pack, see AI authenticity and farm origin, then keep a personal history of every check.
landing.workflowHelp: Don't know our process? Click here for help
landing.workflowDescription: You buy the herb. We show whether that pack is AI-verified and where it came from. Growers list batches in the background — your job is to scan, compare, and buy with confidence.

features.geotaggingDesc: Every listed pack carries farm coordinates so you know where the plant was grown.
features.aiVerificationDesc: A CNN scores the leaf photo against Amla, Guava, Hibiscus, Neem, and Tulsi before a pack is marked genuine.
features.transparencyDesc: Save checks in your consumer account and reopen any QR result later.

upload.title: Upload
upload.description: Farmers upload herb images with geo-tagged location data. Simply drag & drop photos and our system captures the farm coordinates automatically.

aiVerification.title: AI Verification
aiVerification.description: Our custom CNN model analyzes the herb images for authenticity. The AI checks color, texture, shape, and other visual features.

blockchain.title: Blockchain
blockchain.description: Verified records are stored on-chain for immutability. Each batch gets a unique cryptographic hash for tamper-proof tracking.

qrGeneration.title: QR Generation
qrGeneration.description: A unique QR code is generated for each verified batch. This QR code contains the complete traceability information.

consumerScan.title: Consumer Scan
consumerScan.description: End consumers can scan the QR code to verify authenticity. They see the complete journey from farm to their hands.

login.signInDesc: Sign in to save pack scans and browse verified herbs
login.demoCredentials: Shopper demo: consumer@ayurauth.demo — password demo1234@A. Grower demo: farmer@ayurauth.demo

signup.signUpDesc: Track every QR you scan and open verified herb listings. Growers can still list batches after signup from Sell / list a batch.
signup.passwordRequirements: At least 8 characters with letters, numbers, and a symbol (e.g. !@#$)

upload.title: Upload Herb Data
upload.description: Upload herb images with geo-tagged location data for blockchain verification
upload.dragDrop: Drag & drop herb photos here, or click to select

verify.title: Check the pack in your hand
verify.description: Scan the QR on a retail pack or paste the batch ID. We show AI confidence, origin, and whether this listing is verified.
verify.pointCamera: Point camera at QR code to scan
verify.enterId: Enter a QR code or record ID.
verify.notFound: No herb record found for this ID.
verify.enterIdPrompt: Search for a record ID to view verification details.
verify.invalidQR: Invalid QR — No matching record found
verify.malformedQR: Malformed QR — Not a valid AyurAuth code

chatbot.title: AI Assistant
chatbot.subtitle: Information only
chatbot.placeholder: Ask how to scan a pack, read AI scores, or shop verified herbs...
chatbot.welcome: Hi — I'm the AyurAuth shopper assistant. I explain how to scan a pack, read AI authenticity, and browse verified listings. I can't take orders or share contact details.

shop.title: Verified herb listings
shop.description: AI-checked batches you can inspect before you buy. Confirm any pack with the QR on the label.
shop.empty: No listings yet. When growers publish batches, they appear here.
